name: Kingston University London

programs.title: International Business, Economics, Accounting and Finance
programs.summary: Prepare for a degree in Business at this entrepreneurial university. This pathway will cover key industry areas, including marketing, advertising and business economics, to give you the base of knowledge you'll need to study a range of enterprising degrees.

programs.title: Law and Social Sciences
programs.summary: With this pathway, you'll be prepared for degrees in a range of subjects, such as criminology, law, journalism, human rights and sociology. You will gain knowledge of a wide variety of topics, such as politics, economy and social studies and more.

programs.title: Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics
programs.summary: This pathway is for those with scientific minds, who are hoping to study a degree in the above fields. You will be prepared for your undergraduate studies with an introduction to topics like computing and physics.

programs.title: Accounting and Finance
programs.summary: Further your knowledge of finance at Kingston University. Giving you the opportunity to progress to BSc (Hons) Accounting and Finance, this pathway will deliver exposure to topics like law and business analysis.

programs.title: Business Management
programs.summary: Prepare for a business degree in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment. With modules in economics, marketing and business practice, this pathway will give you the vital subject knowledge to study the BSc (Hons) Business Management at Kingston University.

programs.title: Marketing and Advertising
programs.summary: Be inspired by marketing industry exposure during your studies. In preparing for Kingston University's BSc (Hons) Marketing and Advertising, you will learn about subjects such as entrepreneurship, business skills and marketing principles.

programs.title: Business and Management
programs.summary: Our Business and Management pathway will give you all the knowledge needed to study a postgraduate business degree, as well as strengthen your English language and academic study skills.

description: Kingston University is located in the beautiful riverside town of Kingston upon Thames. An ancient market town, it is the ideal place to experience both quiet small-town life whilst having easy access to vibrant city living.
